in_arabic.name: كمالة
in_arabic.meaning: كمالة تعني الكمال أو تمام الشيء

in_urdu.name: کمالہ
in_urdu.meaning: کمالہ کا مطلب ہے مکمل یا کامل کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: کمالہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مکمل یا کامل کرنا۔ یہ نام اکثر اسلامی تقالید میں اچھے اخلاق اور مکمل شخصیت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कमाला
in_hindi.meaning: कमाला का अर्थ है पूर्णता या सम्पूर्णता
in_hindi.long_meaning: कमाला नाम का अर्थ है पूर्णता या सम्पूर्णता। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में अच्छे गुणों और आदर्श व्यक्तित्व के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: کماله
in_pashto.meaning: کماله د کامل یا بشپړتیا معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: کماله نوم د عربي کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې کامل یا بشپړتیا ده. دا نوم په ځینو وختونو کې د الهي یا نبوي صفاتو د بیان لپاره کارول کېږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kamala holds a deep cultural significance for many communities within the Islamic world. The word "Kamala" means "perfection" or "completion" in Arabic, a concept that is highly valued in Islamic culture. This name is often given to newborn girls, symbolizing the hope and dream of their parents for their child to grow up to be the embodiment of perfection and to fulfill all the potentials that their Creator has bestowed upon them. Kamala is a name that represents a goal to be strive for, one that is both admirable and aspirational.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kamala holds deeper meaning in the Islamic faith. It reflects the belief that everything in the universe is a manifestation of Allah's perfect will, and that we as human beings are constantly striving to complete our spiritual journey towards Allah. The name serves as a reminder of our goal to seek eternal perfection through following the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and leading a righteous life in accordance with Islamic principles. By embracing the name Kamala, one is encouraged to continuously pursue personal growth and development, both spiritually and intellectually, in order to realize the ultimate perfection that can only be achieved through close connection with Allah.
